title: Review of Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 Vaccine for Children Aged Five and Under
what_it_is: Review of Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 Vaccine for Children Aged Five and Under

sections.label: Vaccine use for younger children
sections.summary: MOH and the Expert Committee on COVID-19 Vaccination continue to study vaccine strategies for younger children, whose vaccine use is still in clinical trials.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The use of vaccine for younger children is still being studied in clinical trials.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH, in consultation with the Expert Committee on COVID-19 Vaccination, the EC19V, continues to examine different vaccine strategies, based on the risk-benefit assessment to the relevant subpopulation, in the context of the evolving COVID-19 situation.

sections.label: Studying vaccines and community protocols
sections.summary: Singapore studies all clinical data and expert recommendations to assess COVID-19 products for licensing, while parents are advised on hygiene, staying home when unwell, testing and community protocols.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For his second question about other vaccines, we are studying all clinical data that is being produced for all the therapeutic interventions for COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will take that data, we will take the recommendations from our professionals and experts, and we will assess the various products as they become available for licensing here in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In terms of what parents can do, hygiene continues to be important.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Making sure that we stay at home if we are feeling unwell, engage with the testing procedures, the various protocols that we have explained for community protocols – Protocols 1, 2 and 3.

sections.label: Timing and monitoring vaccination effectiveness
sections.summary: The timing and circumstances continue to be studied worldwide and by local experts, and Singapore monitors vaccination effectiveness for children in age groups where vaccines are rolled out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is a matter of timing of those and the circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, the matter continues to be studied by various people around the world, as well as our experts here.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For children in the age groups that the Member mentioned, where the vaccines are already being rolled out, indeed, we continue through our various public health processes, to monitor and measure the effectiveness of the vaccination process.
